about: Every name, description and grade is the official list as PlayStation publishes it. Every guide is written for this entry from the official description plus the PSN progress target where PSNProfiles lists one. The game released 19 November 2026 and this guide has not been checked in the game: where a place or step is not pinned down by a source, the guide says so instead of inventing it.
sources: Exophase official trophy list (exophase.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi-psn/trophies) — name, description and grade of every trophy
PSNProfiles official list (psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi) — grade and PSN progress target where one exists
Own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
sources: Exophase official trophy list — name, description, grade
PSNProfiles official list — grade
Own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game
trophies.guide: The platinum. It unlocks when the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is no separate task: follow the roadmap in order, story first, then side characters, activities, collectibles and money. Keep the two gold trophies in view — the final mission and 100% completion — because they are the longest poles on the road to this one.

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, which the description names as the trigger. It is the first story trophy most players will earn, and it sets up the fishing the later Cal challenge builds on. Because it is the opening mission it is a one-pass moment: play it when the story offers it rather than assuming a replay.

trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape. Both conditions matter: your partner must be with you, and the heat must reach 4 stars before you lose it. Set it up deliberately — partner in the car, raise the wanted level to 4 stars, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until it clears. It is situational rather than story-locked, so it can be attempted whenever your partner is available.

Where Combat Focus is unlocked is not in the description, so no unlock step is claimed.
